ip_data_security.text: ===== FILE: files/36C25026Q0813_1.docx ===== GENERAL INFORMATION CONTACT INFORMATION ADDITIONAL INFORMATION DESCRIPTION The intention of this notice is to obtain a complete, maintained digital wayfinding solution. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, hardware, software, supervision, and other items necessary to deliver a web-based interactive mapping platform, including SaaS hosting and maintenance; interactive digital wayfinding maps incorporating approved campus, floor plan, destination, entrance, parking, and route information; “You Are Here” wall maps in digital-file format only; and up to ten (10) hours of Government-authorized content changes per contract year.
